segments.sn22.87:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn22.87:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā vakkali kumbhakāranivesane viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.sn22.87:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā vakkali upaṭṭhāke āmantesi –
segments.sn22.87:1.4: “etha tumhe, āvuso, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamatha; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha –
segments.sn22.87:1.5: ‘vakkali, bhante, bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno, so bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
segments.sn22.87:1.7: ‘sādhu kira, bhante, bhagavā yena vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu; anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.sn22.87:1.8: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vakkalissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.87:1.9: “vakkali, bhante, bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno, so bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati;
segments.sn22.87:1.11: ‘sādhu kira, bhante, bhagavā yena vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu; anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.sn22.87:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yenāyasmā vakkali tenupasaṅkami.
segments.sn22.87:2.2: Addasā kho āyasmā vakkali bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ. Disvāna mañcake samadhosi [samañcosi (sī.), samañcopi (syā. kaṃ.) saṃ + dhū + ī = samadhosi].
segments.sn22.87:2.3: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.87:2.6: Nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. Nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.87:2.7: “kacci te, vakkali, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti, no abhikkamanti; paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no abhikkamo”ti?
segments.sn22.87:2.8: “Na me, bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ; bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo”ti.
segments.sn22.87:2.9: “Kacci te, vakkali, na kiñci kukkuccaṃ, na koci vippaṭisāro”ti?
segments.sn22.87:2.10: “Taggha me, bhante, anappakaṃ kukkuccaṃ, anappako vippaṭisāro”ti.
segments.sn22.87:2.11: “Kacci pana taṃ, vakkali, attā sīlato na upavadatī”ti?
segments.sn22.87:2.12: “Na kho maṃ, bhante, attā sīlato upavadatī”ti.
segments.sn22.87:2.13: “No ce kira taṃ, vakkali, attā sīlato upavadati; atha kiñca te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāro”ti?
segments.sn22.87:2.14: “Cirapaṭikāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitukāmo, natthi ca me kāyasmiṃ tāvatikā balamattā, yāvatāhaṃ [yāhaṃ (sī.), yāyāhaṃ (pī.)] bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyan”ti.
segments.sn22.87:3.1: “Alaṃ, vakkali, kiṃ te iminā pūtikāyena diṭṭhena?
segments.sn22.87:3.2: Yo kho, vakkali, dhammaṃ passati so maṃ passati;
segments.sn22.87:3.3: yo maṃ passati so dhammaṃ passati.
segments.sn22.87:4.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vakkali, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.87:4.4: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.87:4.6: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn22.87:4.9: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.87:4.16: “Tasmātiha … pe … evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
segments.sn22.87:5.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena gijjhakūṭo pabbato tena pakkāmi.
segments.sn22.87:5.2: Atha kho āyasmā vakkali acirapakkantassa bhagavato upaṭṭhāke āmantesi –
segments.sn22.87:5.3: “etha maṃ, āvuso, mañcakaṃ āropetvā yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkamatha.
segments.sn22.87:5.4: Kathañhi nāma mādiso antaraghare kālaṃ kattabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti?
segments.sn22.87:5.5: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vakkalissa paṭissutvā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ mañcakaṃ āropetvā yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
segments.sn22.87:5.6: Atha kho bhagavā tañca rattiṃ tañca divāvasesaṃ gijjhakūṭe pabbate vihāsi.
segments.sn22.87:5.7: Atha kho dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu … pe … ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
segments.sn22.87:5.8: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.87:5.13: Idaṃ vatvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyiṃsu.
segments.sn22.87:6.1: Atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn22.87:6.2: “etha tumhe, bhikkhave, yena vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatha; upasaṅkamitvā vakkaliṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadetha –
segments.sn22.87:7.1: “‘Suṇāvuso tvaṃ, vakkali, bhagavato vacanaṃ dvinnañca devatānaṃ.
segments.sn22.87:7.2: Imaṃ, āvuso, rattiṃ dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
segments.sn22.87:7.3: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho, āvuso, ekā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – vakkali, bhante, bhikkhu vimokkhāya cetetīti.
segments.sn22.87:7.5: Aparā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – so hi nūna, bhante, suvimutto vimuccissatīti.
segments.sn22.87:7.7: Bhagavā ca taṃ, āvuso vakkali, evamāha – mā bhāyi, vakkali;
segments.sn22.87:7.10: Apāpakaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhavissati, apāpikā kālakiriyā’”ti.
segments.sn22.87:7.11: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā vakkali tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.87:8.1: Atha kho āyasmā vakkali upaṭṭhāke āmantesi –
segments.sn22.87:8.3: Kathañhi nāma mādiso ucce āsane nisīditvā tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ sotabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti!
segments.sn22.87:8.4: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vakkalissa paṭissutvā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ mañcakā oropesuṃ.
segments.sn22.87:8.5: “Imaṃ, āvuso, rattiṃ dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā … pe … ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
segments.sn22.87:8.6: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho, āvuso, ekā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.87:8.10: Bhagavā ca taṃ, āvuso vakkali, evamāha –
segments.sn22.87:8.13: Apāpakaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhavissati, apāpikā kālakiriyā’”ti.
segments.sn22.87:8.14: “Tena hāvuso, mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha –
segments.sn22.87:8.21: Yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmi.
segments.sn22.87:8.25: Yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmi.
segments.sn22.87:8.30: Yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmi.
segments.sn22.87:8.34: Yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmī’”ti.
segments.sn22.87:8.35: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vakkalissa paṭissutvā pakkamiṃsu.
segments.sn22.87:8.36: Atha kho āyasmā vakkali acirapakkantesu tesu bhikkhūsu satthaṃ āharesi.
segments.sn22.87:9.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.87:9.8: Yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmi.
segments.sn22.87:9.15: Yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmī’”ti.
segments.sn22.87:10.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.sn22.87:10.5: Atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkami.
segments.sn22.87:10.6: Addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ dūratova mañcake vivattakkhandhaṃ semānaṃ.
segments.sn22.87:11.1: Tena kho pana samayena dhūmāyitattaṃ timirāyitattaṃ gacchateva purimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uddhaṃ disaṃ, gacchati adho disaṃ, gacchati anudisaṃ.
segments.sn22.87:11.3: “passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ dhūmāyitattaṃ timirāyitattaṃ gacchateva purimaṃ disaṃ … pe … gacchati anudisan”ti.
segments.sn22.87:11.5: “Eso kho, bhikkhave, māro pāpimā vakkalissa kulaputtassa viññāṇaṃ samanvesati [samannesati (ka. sī. pī.)]–
segments.sn22.87:11.7: Appatiṭṭhitena ca, bhikkhave, viññāṇena vakkali kulaputto parinibbuto”ti.

lines: Thero kira vutthavasso pavāretvā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya āgacchati.
Tassa nagaramajjhe mahāābādho uppajji, pādā na vahanti.
Sā ca sālā tesaṃ kammasālā, na nivesanasālā.
Vattaṃ kiretaṃ bāḷhagilānenapi buḍḍhataraṃ disvā uṭṭhānākārena apaciti dassetabbā.
Tena pana “mā cali mā calī”ti vattabbo.
Santimāni āsanānīti buddhakālasmiñhi ekassapi bhikkhuno vasanaṭṭhāne “sace satthā āgacchissati, idha nisīdissatī”ti āsanaṃ paññattameva hoti antamaso phalakamattampi paṇṇasanthāramattampi.
Khamanīyaṃ yāpanīyanti kacci dukkhaṃ khamituṃ iriyāpathaṃ vā yāpetuṃ sakkāti pucchati.
Sīlato na upavadatīti sīlaṃ ārabbha sīlabhāvena na upavadati.
Cirapaṭikāhanti cirapaṭiko ahaṃ, cirato paṭṭhāya ahanti attho.
Pūtikāyenāti attano suvaṇṇavaṇṇampi kāyaṃ bhagavā dhuvapaggharaṇaṭṭhena evamāha.
Yo kho, vakkali, dhammanti idha bhagavā “dhammakāyo kho, mahārāja, tathāgato”ti vuttaṃ dhammakāyataṃ dasseti.
Navavidho hi lokuttaradhammo tathāgatassa kāyo nāma.
Idāni therassa tiparivaṭṭadhammadesanaṃ ārabhanto taṃ kiṃ maññasītiādimāha.
Tā kira devatā “yena nīhārena iminā vipassanā āraddhā, anantarāyena arahattaṃ pāpuṇissatī”ti ñatvā evamāhaṃsu.
So samādhivipassanāhi vikkhambhitānaṃ kilesānaṃ samudācāraṃ apassanto “khīṇāsavomhī”ti saññī hutvā “kiṃ me iminā dukkhena jīvitena?
Satthaṃ āharitvā marissāmī”ti tikhiṇena satthena kaṇṭhanāḷaṃ chindi.
So tasmiṃ khaṇe attano puthujjanabhāvaṃ ñatvā avissaṭṭhakammaṭṭhānattā sīghaṃ mūlakammaṭṭhānaṃ ādāya sammasanto arahattaṃ pāpuṇitvāva kālamakāsi.
Khīṇāsavassa ekūnavīsati paccavekkhaṇā na sabbāva avassaṃ laddhabbā, tikhiṇenāpi pana asinā sīse chijjante ekaṃ dve ñāṇāni avassaṃ uppajjanti.
Thero kira uttānako nipanno satthaṃ āhari.
Ariyasāvakā hi yebhuyyena dakkhiṇapasseneva kālaṃ karonti.
Taṃ sandhāya vivattakkhandho nāma jātotipi vadanti.
Dhūmavalāhakaṃ viya timiravalāhakaṃ viya cāti attho.
Ekaṃ dve ñāṇānīti ekaṃ dve paccavekkhaṇañāṇāni sabhāvato avassaṃ uppajjanti, ayaṃ dhammatā.
